headline: Woman accuses Graham Platner of sexual assault. And, NATO summit begins
context: Graham Platner is facing calls to end his bid for U.S. Senate in Maine after a woman accused him of sexual assault. And, Trump made his dissatisfaction with NATO clear ahead of its summit this week.
